summary: This is an 8-K filed by Vista Credit Strategic Lending Corp. on July 2, 2026, reporting a routine monthly distribution for June 2026. The company announced a gross distribution of $0.15000 per share for Class I and Class S common stock, with a net distribution for Class S of $0.13667 after a shareholder servicing fee. The record date is June 30, 2026, with payment on or about July 27, 2026. Distributions may be paid in cash or reinvested under the company's distribution reinvestment plan. This is ordinary course dividend activity and does not constitute a special situation event.
